population_policy.aer: One hash target is the median of existing alias-level warm_execution labels; metric population is finite hash targets.

scope: Separate exact-hash OOF summaries for Aer Azizov adaptation and fixed-MPS chi16; no cross-engine, cross-clock or cross-target pooling.
